I verified the work from the last session. Update `Plan.md` now:

1. Ask me which tasks are verified only if it is not clear from the conversation. Otherwise tick (`[x]`) exactly the tasks we just completed. Never tick a task that was not demonstrated to work.
2. Update the phase status emoji: ⬜ to 🟨 when some tasks are done, 🟨 to ✅ only when every task in the phase is ticked AND its "Done when" line is true.
3. Update the "N / 8 phases done" counter and the status table at the top.
4. Add a Progress Log row: today's date, the phase, and one short note about what was built or any decision made.
5. Show me a short diff summary of what changed, then tell me the next 2 to 3 tasks.
